correctness.rationale: Exactly enumerate all successful n<=3 preference words: reverse-TP2 holds for ALL strictly positive preference laws because lucky-count rows have decreasing nonoverlapping displacement supports. At n=4, directly count weighted joint cells W(2,2)=128, W(2,3)=80, W(3,2)=64, W(3,3)=48 from 256 words; the minor 128*48-80*64=1024>0. Success total weight 776 and conditional normalization preserve sign. Independently reimplemented enumeration in independent_checks.py and verified exact cells. Quantifiers and conditioning explicit; no inference on uniform n=4 or weaker covariance.

value.rationale: A minimal counterexample to reverse likelihood-ratio stochastic ordering of luck and displacement is a substantive natural boundary: first failure at four cars, despite strictly positive iid weights with only factor-two bias. This prevents an otherwise plausible strong association theorem while leaving weaker notions open.
